ticker: US administration unveils new tariffs after excess capacity probe
US spy agencies hit by significant unclassified cybersecurity breach
China and India set for record Russian oil imports in 2026
CrowdStrike buys Jay Chaudhry's Zscaler in massive $44bn deal
Israel opposition leaders clinch crucial coalition pact to oust Netanyahu

articles.headline: US Administration Unveils New Tariffs Following Capacity Probe
articles.brief: The U.S. Trade Representative’s office is preparing to propose new duties stacking on top of existing tariffs following a comprehensive investigation into excess industrial manufacturing capacity across international markets.

articles.headline: US Intelligence Agencies Suffer Unclassified Cybersecurity Breach
articles.brief: The CIA and the Office of the Director of National Intelligence have detected a cybersecurity breach involving unclassified data. Initial assessments point toward potential foreign involvement utilizing advanced artificial intelligence tools.

articles.headline: China and India Eye Record Russian Oil Imports
articles.brief: Driven by ongoing Middle East conflicts disrupting conventional supply routes, both China and India are projected to reach record Russian crude oil import volumes, though demand is expected to peak soon.

articles.headline: CrowdStrike Acquired Zscaler in $44 Billion Cloud Security Merger
articles.brief: In a historic tech transaction, cybersecurity giant CrowdStrike has officially acquired Jay Chaudhry’s cloud security company Zscaler in a massive $44 billion buyout deal, reshaping the global enterprise security landscape.

articles.headline: Israel Opposition Leaders Form Strategic Coalition Agreement
articles.brief: Gadi Eisenkot and Avigdor Lieberman have finalized a landmark coalition agreement, forming a unified political alliance in an intensified legislative push to challenge and unseat Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

articles.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Discusses Accountability and Therapy
articles.brief: Following his sudden reinstatement as Nvidia CEO, Jensen Huang addressed employees candidly about personal conduct violations, announcing enhanced performance frameworks and daily therapy as part of his personal accountability efforts.

articles.headline: Gukesh Secures Tactical Draw against Javokhir Sindarov
articles.brief: Grandmaster Gukesh demonstrated exceptional defensive resilience during the opening round of the World Chess Championship, neutralising Javokhir Sindarov’s aggressive attack under severe time pressure to secure a psychologically vital draw.

articles.headline: Tamil Nadu State Secures Over $5.38 Billion Investment Deals
articles.brief: Industry sources report that India's Tamil Nadu state government is finalizing major corporate investment agreements exceeding $5.38 billion, significantly boosting regional industrial growth and manufacturing capacities.
